lastCompletedStory.title: Rewrite ensurePushed to compare-first (read-only ls-remote) before pushing

nextStoryContext: This PRD (CAM-156) contained a single story, US-001, now passes:true. src/supervisor/host.ts:749-798 old push-then-compare ensurePushed was rewritten as two pure helpers (resolveEnsurePushed + pushThenCompare, exported via GitSpawnFn) placed just before buildSupervisorOptions; the production wiring inside buildSupervisorOptions now just calls resolveEnsurePushed(gitSpawnFn, cwd). Return contract { ok, pushed, sha, detail } is byte-identical to before, so loop.ts/events.ts consumers and the existing loop.test.ts US-001/US-002 fake-injection tests needed zero changes. host.ts grew past its file-size ceiling (959->1018); the budget was raised with a dated _ref note (no other files need action). No further stories pending in this PRD; review/ship is next.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure node:child_process/spawnSync git-plumbing change; git ls-remote output-format assumption (tab-separated <sha> <ref>, empty stdout + exit 0 for missing branch, non-zero exit on network/auth failure) cross-checked against git-scm.com/docs/git-ls-remote and confirmed aligned with the implementation.
